insights.would_multipass_help: no - the core facts (Kirk's death, Massie's party, rally date/purpose) were all confirmed in rounds 1-2. Additional passes would add detail but not change the Community Notes angle.
insights.deepseek_advice: When a tweet from a political organization uses tribal framing ('Trump haters') about a specific named target, always search the target's party affiliation and the organization's history with that target - the factual gap is usually in what the framing conceals. Also check whether the organization's leadership has recently changed, especially for orgs whose founders are prominent public figures.
